description: Default capability for the dreamcontext desktop shell. Grants the tightest permission set needed: core defaults, multi-window creation, native folder dialog, opening external URLs (shell:allow-open — target=_blank links / Open GitHub), Dock-bounce + native notification banners for the "Claude is asking" alarm, shell spawn/kill scoped to the Node child, and claiming a parked dreamcontext:// link (allow-take-app-link). The owner key (`owner_key`) is NOT granted here: this capability allows every loopback port, so a web card's frame would pass it. The shell adds the `owner-key` capability at runtime, scoped to the server's exact port, for `assistant`, `main` and `vault-*` (src/owner_key.rs `grant`). The Notifications window (`inbox`) is here too because it routes links exactly like a project window does: it emits to other windows and opens project and viewer windows. The Telegram confirms (src/telegram_confirm.rs) raise a native alert and post with the owner key themselves; the key never reaches the page. `allow-html-snapshot` renders a server-built page in the sealed `html-snapshot` window, which no capability matches.
